summary:
Iter 150 — Queue tab + TruncatedRosterPanel + admin-team seed + Draft Board megaphone. Backend: 6/6 static pytest PASS (test_iter150_queue_tab_and_roster_panel.py) + 8/8 NEW live pytest PASS (test_iter150_live.py) on https://dynasty-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend Playwright: 7/8 acceptance items PASS LIVE. ONE CRITICAL BUG: clicking the propose-trade icon (data-testid='draft-room-roster-trade-{playerId}') in TruncatedRosterPanel crashes the page with 'TypeError: Cannot destructure property leagueId of undefined as it is undefined.' Root cause: DraftRoom.tsx line 1066 calls tradeBuilder.openBuilder() with NO arguments, but openBuilder destructures { leagueId } from its first arg. Compare to the working call at line 462 — tradeBuilder.openBuilder({ leagueId: activeLeagueCtx.id, myTeam }). One-line fix needed in DraftRoom.tsx.

Verified LIVE on /draft-room after admin login (admin@dynastydreams.com / Admin123!):

• Clicking ListOrdered button on an eligible row: queue count went 0→1, draft-room-status-queued-{id} icon appeared on that row, queue tab content visible (data-testid='draft-room-queue-list' confirmed).
• Clicking Star button on an eligible row: shortlist count went 0→1, draft-room-status-shortlisted-{id} icon appeared.
• TruncatedRosterPanel renders with header 'My Roster', team-switcher labeled 'Ice Breakers (you)', stat filter defaulting to 'Season (overall)', and exactly 10 roster rows (Jesper Bratt, Pavel Dorofeyev, Dylan Strome, Filip Forsberg, Jack Hughes, Ryan McLeod, Luke Evangelista, J.T. Miller, Jack Eichel, Lucas Raymond) sorted by FP desc.
• Team switcher opens a dropdown listing all 14 teams. Switched to 'Zarek's Frozen' → roster reloaded and header changed to 'Zarek's Frozen'.
• Stat filter dropdown lists exactly 5 options ['Season (overall)', 'Regular Season', 'Playoffs', 'Last 30 days', 'Last 7 days']. Selecting 'Last 30 days' re-fetched and rendered 10 rows.
• Player names link to /players/{id} (href='/players/69e43d98b80cbdcecf495277' verified).
• Backend GET /api/teams/{team_id}/roster-truncated returns 200 with shape {team_id, stat_filter, players:[{id,name,position,fantasy_points,fp_per_game,cap_hit,games_played}]}, 10 entries, sorted by fantasy_points desc, all 5 stat_filter values accepted, unknown team returns 404.
• Admin user 69dc63e232b1b7aac227c0a3 IS now owner of team 69e59b33cbd3fea02a914c7b 'Ice Breakers' in league 69e46af167999bfb85c39629 (verified via /api/teams?league_id=…).
• Draft Board static check: ShoppingCart replaced with Megaphone for 'Available' badge, both testids present (draft-board-block-icon-{abbr}-r{round} + traded variant). Runtime not reproducible because all 8 trade-block items in this seed are PLAYERS (item_type='player'), not picks, so no pick cells show the badge — wiring is correct.
• Read-only megaphone overlay column on TruncatedRosterPanel did NOT render at runtime because the trade-block player IDs assigned to each team in the seed do not actually exist in that team's truncated roster (player 69e43d98b80cbdcecf4952ee/4952aa on team Ice Breakers are not in Ice Breakers' /roster-truncated). Source wiring is verified by static test (draft-room-roster-block-{p.id} testid present).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the propose-trade icon (data-testid='draft-room-roster-trade-{playerId}') in /draft-room throws an uncaught runtime error overlay: TypeError: Cannot destructure property 'leagueId' of 'undefined' as it is undefined. at Object.openBuilder (TradeBuilderContext). The Trade Builder never opens, no sonner toast appears, the page becomes unusable until reload. RCA: DraftRoom.tsx line 1066 — onPickPlayerForTrade={(team, player) => { if (!tradeBuilder.isOpen) tradeBuilder.openBuilder(); ... }} calls openBuilder() with NO ARGUMENTS, but openBuilder destructures { leagueId } from its first arg. The other call site at line 462 correctly passes { leagueId: activeLeagueCtx.id, myTeam }. FIX: replace `tradeBuilder.openBuilder()` on line 1066 with `tradeBuilder.openBuilder({ leagueId: activeLeagueCtx.id, myTeam });` (or fall back to leagueId from team.leagueId if myTeam is null).

Tabs strip uses live counts on Queue and Shortlist tab labels — good UX. Status icons (Star amber / ListOrdered primary) on each eligible row also have tooltips. Both icons use the proper template-literal testids for downstream e2e tests.

rca of the issue: DraftRoom.tsx line 1066 inside the <TruncatedRosterPanel onPickPlayerForTrade={...}> callback invokes `tradeBuilder.openBuilder()` without arguments. The TradeBuilderContext.openBuilder signature expects `({ leagueId, myTeam }) => void` and immediately destructures `leagueId` → when called with undefined the engine throws TypeError. Reproduction: login as admin → /draft-room → wait for TruncatedRosterPanel to load → click the small Repeat (propose-trade) icon (data-testid prefix 'draft-room-roster-trade-') on ANY row → red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay covers the page with the leagueId destructure stack. Mitigation: change line 1066 to `if (!tradeBuilder.isOpen) tradeBuilder.openBuilder({ leagueId: activeLeagueCtx.id, myTeam });` matching the established pattern at line 462. Note that activeLeagueCtx and myTeam are already in scope at this call site (they are used elsewhere in the component).
